text:
anya: Quick thread for partners: we're planning a minor-but-breaking SDK rename ("batch_size" -> "batch") + tightening delegated auth. This affects connectors, marketplace listings, and some firmware-embedded SDKs. Need plan for low-friction partner migration.

omar: Marketplace note: some partners ship connectors that live in partner-managed repos. They'll need a changelog snippet and a compatibility flag they can test against. Can we provide a compatibility test badge?

suki: We can expose a status endpoint `/compat/v2/health` on a test host and a badge URL. Also propose a short-lived edge shim to translate params for partners that can't ship quickly (max 30 days).

drew: From SDK side: we'll publish v2 clients with explicit opt-in header `X-RW-SDK-Compat: 2`. Without the header server behaves v1-like. We'll add examples for curl/python/node.

mike: SRE asks for telemetry keys: `compat.header_seen`, `compat.translation_used`, `compat.auth_fail`. We'll create dashboards and alert if auth_fail spikes per partner. I can own runbook.

hw-partner-rep: FYI: hardware partners often freeze SDKs into firmware images with long release cycles. They'll need a longer migration runway (60-90 days) or we ship a binary shim for their firmware pipelines.

anya: Good catch. Options for firmware partners: 1) provide a small C shim that maps `batch`->`batch_size` in their packaged client, 2) extend edge shim to tag specific partner IDs for longer grace period, or 3) coordinate a staged firmware release plan. Which is feasible?
hw-partner-rep: Option 2 is best short term; option 1 requires our eng time but would be cleaner. We'll send a list of impacted partners tomorrow.

suki: Actionable rollout pieces: - test host: `compat-v2-test.redwood.ai` (suki) - edge shim translation (drew + mike) - SDK v2 release + samples (drew) - firmware shim binary (eng-queue request) - marketplace changelog & badge (omar) - partner opt-in form + office hours (anya)

drew: Example header usage in samples:
```
# curl
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-RW-SDK-Compat: 2" \\  
  https://compat-v2-test.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"batch":4}'
```

omar: We'll add a marketplace blocker flag that prevents automatic promotion of connectors until partner confirms tests passed. Also request a short migration blurb we can embed in connector pages.

mike: Monitoring thresholds: if any partner has >0.75% auth failures or >1% overall error delta after opt-in, auto-pause translation for that partner and page on-call. Add alerts to #eng-oncall and #partnerships.

anya: Draft timeline suggestion: Day 0 announce + partner survey; Day 2 test host + samples; Day 7 opt-in canary (select marketplace connectors + 2 hardware partners); Day 14 enable edge shim for non-opt-ins (30d window default, extendable per partner); Day 45 firmware shim deadline for partners who accepted assistance; Day 75 final removal of shim for general partners, hardware partners handled case-by-case.

hw-partner-rep: Please add us to opt-in list ASAP. We'll prioritize firmware partners that have >10k deployed devices.

suki: We'll also produce a short SI checklist (grep for "batch_size", search for hardcoded auth headers, test on test host). Will include sample patch for quick fixes.

drew: Note: auth tightening requires `x-rw-user` header for delegated calls. We'll include fallback guidance for token-based flows.

mike: I'll own the SRE checklist and will add the `compat.*` metrics and dashboards today. Also will prepare rollback playbook for partner-specific rollbacks.

deploy-bot: Edge shim deployed to stage env `shim-stage-2123`. Canary started (4 connectors, 8% traffic). id: canary-2123456820-a.

anya: Owners recap: partner comms & opt-in form: anya; marketplace coordination & badge: omar; SDK samples & v2 release: drew; edge shim + monitoring: mike; firmware partner assist: hw-partner-rep + eng queue; SI checklist & docs: suki. I'll draft partner email & marketplace blurb tonight.

omar: We'll hold a 45-minute partner office hour on Day 3 and record it. Put slides + migration checklist in the partner repo.

anya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the migration guide link when it's up and tag partner POCs. :rocket:
